# Florida Rednecks

> A fun, respectful guide to Florida country and outdoor life: freshwater and saltwater fishing spots, airboats and swamp culture, boiled peanuts and Southern food, hunting and fishing licenses (via FWC), and rural hurricane prep.

## Pages

- [Home](https://floridarednecks.com/): Overview of Florida Rednecks' outdoor and country-life guides with key facts and FAQs.
- [Best Florida Fishing Spots: Freshwater and Saltwater Favorites](https://floridarednecks.com/florida-fishing-spots.html): Bass lakes, big rivers, redfish flats, tarpon passes and Gulf and Atlantic piers, with what bites where and when.
- [Airboats and Florida Swamp Culture: A Guide to the River of Grass](https://floridarednecks.com/airboats-swamp-culture.html): How airboats work, Everglades history, swamp buggies and Cracker heritage, plus rules and safety for riding and wildlife.
- [Boiled Peanuts and Florida Southern Food: Recipes and Traditions](https://floridarednecks.com/boiled-peanuts-southern-food.html): A real boiled peanut recipe, plain and Cajun, plus smoked mullet, swamp cabbage, gator tail and other Florida country classics.
- [Florida Hunting and Fishing Licenses: What You Need and Who's Exempt](https://floridarednecks.com/florida-hunting-fishing-licenses.html): Freshwater vs. saltwater licenses, hunting permits, exemptions, hunter safety and where to buy, straight from FWC sources.
- [Hurricane Prep for Rural Floridians: Wells, Generators, Livestock and More](https://floridarednecks.com/rural-hurricane-prep-florida.html): Supplies, generators, wells and septic, livestock, mobile homes and insurance: hurricane prep when help is farther away.
- [About](https://floridarednecks.com/about.html): What Florida Rednecks is, what it covers, and its commitment to accurate, respectful content.
- [Contact](https://floridarednecks.com/contact.html): How to reach Florida Rednecks by email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://floridarednecks.com/privacy.html): What data the site collects and how it is used.
